name: HIPER Global / Mister H
summary: A recurring AI virtual ambassador designed to communicate HIPER Global's expertise through short-form content.
challenge: Give a B2B company a consistent, recognisable on-screen presence without the cost and scheduling of live production.

evidence.label: Owner-confirmed project concept
evidence.notes: The concept is confirmed. The tool chain is not: any specific tools mentioned elsewhere for this project are inferred from adjacent work and must not be stated as fact.

conversation_hooks.recruiter_intent: Assess applied generative AI in a commercial context
conversation_hooks.agent_response_goal: Show that the AI work is applied to real business communication problems, not only to creative experiments.

presentation.short_pitch: A recurring AI virtual ambassador for a B2B brand's short-form content.
presentation.long_pitch: An AI-generated recurring character built to carry HIPER Global's expertise into short-form content with a consistent on-screen presence.
suggested_followups: Want to see the more technical generative AI work behind something like this?

open_questions: Confirm the actual tools and workflow used.
Confirm whether this shipped or remained a concept — this materially changes how the agent should describe it.

peek.hook: An AI character built to carry a B2B brand.
peek.supporting: Generative AI applied to a real communication problem, not an experiment.
